title: D'Andre Swift received no in-game medical treatment for gash on knee

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: D'Andre Swift received no in-game medical treatment for gash on knee
sources.description: Given the recent talk about the medical care provided to NFL players (I'll now wonder whether any "calf" injury is actually a blood clot), more attention will be paid to whether the practices match the principles that were stridently articulated earlier this week by chief medical officer Allen Sills.
